shared_elements: animal in profile, in low relief
relief carving on a vertical stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief animal imagery in profile, but that is essentially all they share: A shows a single schematic, sparsely outlined creature (with an isolated angular sign) on a plain pillar face, while B shows a naturalistic, fully modelled two-humped camel led by striding human figures in patterned garments, framed above and below by bands of rosettes. The presence of human attendants, a processional register, and decorative borders in B has no counterpart in A, and the rendering conventions (spare incised outline versus rounded volumetric modelling with anatomical detail) are quite different.
